diet_recommendations.recommendation: Monitor Dairy products, Wheat/Gluten, Onions carefully
diet_recommendations.rationale: These foods may contribute to your symptoms. Reduce portion sizes and frequency over 2-3 weeks.

diet_recommendations.recommendation: Incorporate Rice, Bananas, Carrots, Chicken breast, Oats as staples
diet_recommendations.rationale: These foods have shown to be well-tolerated in your diet history. Incorporate as staples in your meal planning.

diet_recommendations.recommendation: Increase intake of Warm water, Herbal teas, Electrolyte solutions
diet_recommendations.rationale: Proper hydration supports digestive health and can reduce constipation. Aim for 8-10 glasses daily, warm liquids preferred.

lifestyle_recommendations.recommendation: Try gentle yoga or stretching for 15-20 minutes
lifestyle_recommendations.rationale: Gentle movement can help with digestion without overexertion

lifestyle_recommendations.recommendation: Eat smaller, more frequent meals (5-6 times daily)
lifestyle_recommendations.rationale: Reduces digestive burden and prevents symptom spikes

lifestyle_recommendations.recommendation: Chew food thoroughly and eat slowly
lifestyle_recommendations.rationale: Improves digestion and reduces gas formation
